per_finding.notes: Probe HOME REVF-HC-r3-probe/h1 was seeded from the base (b654bc1) installers: rt_deploy_reconciler_snapshots, plus the install-body.sh rule sync and global-recommended-tools.mdc copied to rules/recommended-tools.mdc. The global variant ('Global recommended tools — five_tool_routed stack (always enforced)') was moved. The project variant is moved in the unit test. An edited description is kept and reported. Across git history every shipped rule has exactly one description line, and each one matches RULES. Mutant (drop the global description) -> test fails.
User files (mygate.sh, lib/mine.sh, link.sh) stay, and so do their hooks.json entries. But the exact-name list misses 24 files that the base installers deployed. See the major issue.

reachable() checks every path component under the Cursor home, for moves and for save_json. The test covers .silver-bullet, rules, a plugin cache dir and plugins/ (the registry rewrite). Mutant (reachable bypass) -> 2 failures.

With a regular file where the backup folder goes: rc=1, ERROR lines, no traceback, and the other steps continue. A BOM or bad UTF-8 hooks.json gives rc=1 with a ConfigError message and no traceback. Mutant (catch only ConfigError) -> test error.
Run in a sandbox copy. Dropping the ${HOME} toolstack spelling -> FAILED (failures=1). Dropping live-publish-evidence.json from STATE_FILES -> FAILED (failures=1). Baseline OK.

manifest.json has 95 rows, validator default 95, OK 95/95. No test or generator still hard-codes 96 for this manifest. Pre-existing, not HC: MANIFEST.md and the deploy-tier.sh block message say 85/85, as on the base.
Explicitly handed to G6a by the author, consistent with DECISIONS.md.

issues.problem: The r2 narrowing to exact names leaves most of the global toolstack behind, and reports it as the user's own. Every base install-cursor.sh run (and install-body.sh / install-recommended-tools-cursor.sh) calls rt_installer_post_install -> rt_deploy_reconciler_snapshots (base scripts/lib/recommended-tools/installer.sh:16-66). That function also deploys: lib/recommended-tools/* (17 files), lib/five_tool_runtime/*.py (4 files; also install-global-toolstack.sh:11,47), reconcile-recommended-tools.sh, opencode-rtk-plugin.ts and pi-five-tool-stack.ts. None of these is in TOOLSTACK_FILES, and only lib/common.sh is handled under lib/. The CHANGELOG says the global toolstack is removed, and round 1 did move it whole, so this is a regression. Separately, base install-body.sh:124-127 synced graphify.mdc ('graphify knowledge graph context') and context-mode.mdc ('context-mode routing rules for context window protection') into ~/.cursor/rules. They are not in RULES and are left silently, with no note.
issues.evidence: HOME=REVF-HC-r3-probe/h1, seeded with source base/scripts/lib/recommended-tools/installer.sh; rt_deploy_reconciler_snapshots base. Running the cleanup gives rc=0, '27 change(s)', and 24 lines of the form 'kept: .../hooks/toolstack/lib/recommended-tools/installer.sh: not a Silver Bullet toolstack file, left in place' (likewise for probe-*.sh, receipts.sh, five_tool_runtime/cli.py, reconcile-recommended-tools.sh, *.ts). find then shows those 24 files plus rules/graphify.mdc and rules/context-mode.mdc still present.
issues.suggested_fix: Add reconcile-recommended-tools.sh, opencode-rtk-plugin.ts and pi-five-tool-stack.ts to TOOLSTACK_FILES. Treat lib/recommended-tools/ and lib/five_tool_runtime/ as SB-owned (exact base file names, or the whole dir once lib/common.sh carries the SB header). Add graphify.mdc and context-mode.mdc to RULES with their exact descriptions, or report them explicitly as left for the vendor. Seed a test from the real installer.sh deploy list, e.g. a fixture listing every file rt_deploy_reconciler_snapshots and install-global-toolstack.sh wrote.

issues.problem: In --dry-run nothing is moved, so the trailing rglob reports every SB toolstack file as 'kept: ... not a Silver Bullet toolstack file, left in place', right after 'would move' for the same file. The preview the CHANGELOG tells users to run first is self-contradictory.
issues.evidence: --dry-run on a copy of h1 prints 'kept: .../toolstack/graphify-gate.sh: not a Silver Bullet toolstack file' for graphify-gate.sh, rtk-gate.sh, install.sh, lib/common.sh and others. The tree is unchanged (stat diff identical), so dry-run itself is safe.
issues.suggested_fix: Collect the set of paths this run moved or would move, and exclude them from the leftover report (or skip the report in dry-run).

issues.problem: The backup bucket itself is not symlink-checked. If ~/.cursor/.silver-bullet-legacy-backup is a symlink, every moved item lands in its target outside ~/.cursor. Two runs in the same UTC second share a bucket, and shutil.move into an existing directory nests the source inside it.
issues.evidence: s1: .silver-bullet-legacy-backup -> s1/out. The run moved rules/leanctx.mdc to s1/out/<stamp>/rules/leanctx.mdc.
issues.suggested_fix: Refuse, or use a fresh unique bucket, when the bucket path or any of its parents is a symlink. Make the stamp unique, e.g. with microseconds or mkdtemp.
